title: Next increment — exact occurrence-level, bitemporal provenance

Retractions of provenance links must not imply falsity of the source claim.
Extend admission tests with contradictory evidence, multiple parents, deduplicated syndication, cross-span quotations, publication vs observation cutoffs and source replacement.
Retain old artifacts and qualification receipts; do not silently promote experimental head to production.
Use new Rasen Falcon mailbox lane librarian_v2 under authenticated CHATGPT. Check unread requests with project.requests.list(componentId=librarian_v2,unreadOnly=true).
